disclaimer: MOCK DATA — synthetic demonstration values, not model output.

model_card.target: Recorded façade problem (UNSAFE/SWARMP filing or façade violation) within 12 months
model_card.score_definition: Normalized inspection-priority score (0–1): predicted 12-month probability weighted by consequence (occupancy, pedestrian exposure) and rescaled across scored buildings.
limitations: Ranks buildings for human review; it is not a structural simulation and does not predict collapse.
InSAR measures line-of-sight motion; vertical settlement is not reconstructed.
Buildings with sparse inspection history are scored with less certainty.
Recorded outcomes depend on owners filing; non-filers are missing not at random.
